name: freecad-mcp-bridge
description: Connect to a running FreeCAD session through the FreeCAD MCP Bridge addon.
long_description:
Connects to an open FreeCAD session, so Claude can run Python in FreeCAD and read the output.

Needs FreeCAD's MCP Bridge addon. Setup instructions are in the [README on GitHub](https://github.com/CREATeNG/freecad-mcp-bridge#readme).

host.title: FreeCAD machine
host.description: The address or hostname of the machine running FreeCAD (127.0.0.1 by default; localhost, ::1, and 127.x.x.x are treated as loopback). Beyond loopback, also set Bearer token and TLS certificate file (PEM) below.

port.title: FreeCAD MCP Bridge port
port.description: Requires the MCP Bridge addon installed and switched on in FreeCAD. Must match the port of the FreeCAD machine's entry in FreeCAD's Edit → Preferences → MCP Bridge → Listen addresses. Extension 0.1.27.

token.title: Bearer token
token.description: Optional on loopback, where the extension reads the token file FreeCAD writes at the first start, and a paste of at least 32 characters replaces that file for every client (a shorter token is ignored). Required beyond loopback, where the pasted token is used by the extension only.

tls_cert_file.title: TLS certificate file (PEM)
tls_cert_file.description: Leave blank on loopback, where the bridge serves HTTP. Required beyond loopback: set this to FreeCAD's certificate file so the extension connects over HTTPS and trusts only that certificate.
